views: view1: แปลนคานและพื้น ชั้นที่ 2 1:200 — beams B1..B16, R1..R16, Bx (this split: beam_plan)
view2: same drawing — slab marks HC / S1 / S2 / S3 / S3/1 / S5 / RS1..RS4 + บันได 1 (split: etc_plan, _view2_etc_plan_slab)
note at bottom left: 'น.น. บรรทุกปลอดภัยพื้น HC 300 kg/m' (carried in the slab file)
warnings: Second-floor beams of S-04. Grid ids from the A-09 bubbles (no bubbles on S-sheets). Printed chains: x 1.50 + 20 x 4.00 + 1.50; y 1.50 / 2.50 / 5.50 / 2.50 / 1.50 (both sides), A-C 8.00, and 4.00 + 1.50 below D for the stair projection.

Cantilever floor RS1 (1.50) runs along both long sides: top edge on line A'''' (every bay except the stair bays 4-5 / 17-18), bottom edge on line D'' (every bay; at the stair bays the line carries B13). The edge beams R5 / R5/1 / R1 / R1/1 sit on the tips of the R6 / R4 / R3 / B9/1 / R16/1 cantilevers — bears_on_beam flags list the supporting beam at each end where it is not a column.

The bottom R5 in bays 3-4, 5-6, 16-17 and 18-19 is split at the side edges of the stair projection (3''', 5'', 16'', 18'') because the projection's side beam R1 lands on it there (spec 5, a grid line in between).

Stair projection D-E''(16.0) at bays 4-5 / 17-18: B9 runs D-E on the stair grids (column C5 at E), B13 on line D'' bears on B9 mid-span, R16 at E, R16/1 stubs and B9/1 cantilevers out to the projection edge (1.50 past E and 1.50 either side of the bay, printed on A-09 and on this sheet).

Floor-2 stair opening beam B3 (second one) is on line B'''''''''''''''' = 5.45: S-13 prints 2.55 from the row-C beam and 2.95 from row B; scaling S-04 gives ~5.44, agreeing. That beam bears on B7 both ends.

The row-C beam of the stair bay is labelled B6 on this plan but 'B2' in the stair section S-13 (top left). Plan label kept here (plan decides the mark at a position); the conflict is repeated in the S-13 file.
Grid 2 and grid 20 below row D print two 'R6' labels either side of one beam line (and grid 20 also above row A); recorded as one R6 per line.

Bx (pipe-duct box outside A1 / A21): placed on dummy lines scaled from the grid, same as Gx/Gy on S-03 (confidence 0.6). The outer vertical of the box carries no mark on this plan -> element_id null with element_name_assigned.
